_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: 16-digit numeric string, unique across the database

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

app.description: Application context of the document: Auto = automotive caliper MES, Gamp = pharmaceutical GMP, Common = reference data shared by both

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

equipmentName.description: Display value of equipmentId, copied from u_mes_mast_equipment.name

engineeringChangeName.description: Display value of engineeringChangeId, copied from u_mes_prod_engineeringChange.title

protocolControlledDocumentId.description: Reference to u_mes_syst_controlledDocument._id: protocol controlled document

protocolControlledDocumentName.description: Display value of protocolControlledDocumentId, copied from u_mes_syst_controlledDocument.title

reportControlledDocumentId.description: Reference to u_mes_syst_controlledDocument._id: report controlled document

reportControlledDocumentName.description: Display value of reportControlledDocumentId, copied from u_mes_syst_controlledDocument.title

executedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user recorded for 'executed'

executedBy.description: Display name of the user in executedById, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

approvedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user recorded for 'approved'

approvedBy.description: Display name of the user in approvedById, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

electronicSignatureName.description: Display value of electronicSignatureId, copied from u_mes_syst_electronicSignature.recordNo

requalificationDueDate.description: Date the next requalification is due

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1

createdAt.description: Date and time the document was created. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

createdById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that created the document

createdBy.description: Display name of the creator, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

updatedAt.description: Date and time of the most recent update. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

updatedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that last updated the document

updatedBy.description: Display name of the last updater, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName
